reports.title: FLOWERS FOODS, INC. REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

desk.headline: Sales down 4.7% to $1.17bn, missed; 2026 outlook cut for sales, EBITDA and EPS
results: Net sales fell 4.7% to $1.17bn: price and mix added 2.3% but volume dropped 7.0%; branded retail fell 5.1% with volume down 8.6%.
Adjusted EPS dropped to $0.10 from $0.23, below the $0.15 estimate; GAAP net income fell 64% to $14.4m.
Adjusted EBITDA fell 33% to $78.9m and the margin slid 2.8 points to 6.8%, on lower volumes, more marketing, higher logistics costs and more bought-in product.
The CEO said the Nature's Own relaunch is improving step by step but more slowly than hoped, mainly in loaf bread.
Year-to-date operating cash flow held at $319.9m; dividends paid fell to $107.6m from $157.0m and net debt repayments were $80m.

guidance.summary: Flowers cut its 2026 outlook: sales of $5.016–5.063bn (down 3.7–4.6%), adjusted EBITDA of $415–430m and adjusted EPS of $0.63–0.68, all below earlier ranges. It expects conditions to stay tough near term.

watch: Whether Nature's Own volumes stabilise after the relaunch.
Promotional pressure and its effect on margins in the bread category.
Cash flow, debt reduction and the dividend.
